messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: clickId in plotOutput seems to break when tab added
parts:
I made a simple barplot that would change the colour of a bar if it was clicked on. It worked perfectly. I added a second tab and this broke the barplot functionality - the x values that were being returned were skewed (seem to be shifted down by a constant).

It might be possible to work around by calibrating a constant to subtract, but a proper solution would be ideal.

messages.author: 2ed19a7addb843f5
messages.subject: Re: clickId in plotOutput seems to break when tab added
parts:
Sure. The click value for x is negative in some cases when all the values in the data are positive.

#####ui.R
library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel("plot feedback"),


  sidebarPanel( textInput("Title","title")


  ),

  mainPanel(
    tabsetPanel(id = "tabid",
      tabPanel("Plot", h3("Plot"),plotOutput("myplot",clickId="myplotclick"), verbatimTextOutput("txt"), value="first"), 
      tabPanel("Summary", h3("test"), value="second") 

    )
  )
))


####server.R

library(shiny)

shinyServer(function(input, output, session) {

data <- rnorm(5000)*10)

output$txt<-renderPrint({ as.vector(input$myplotclick)})

output$myplot <- renderPlot ({plot(data)})

})
